text:
### Insider Fraud
**What It Is:** Staff member uses position to commit fraud
**Signs:** Unusual account access, undocumented transactions, authority abuse
**Prevention:** Access controls, audit logs, whistleblower reporting
name: Chunk 37/61

raw_entities.name: Unusual Account Access by Staff Member
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating that a staff member is accessing customer accounts in an unusual or suspicious manner, potentially indicative of insider fraud. This warning sign requires investigation and escalation through appropriate channels.
context: Unusual account access
Staff member uses position to commit fraud
Signs: Unusual account access, undocumented transactions, authority abuse

raw_entities.name: Undocumented Transactions on Customer Account
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating transactions that lack proper documentation or audit trail, potentially indicating insider fraud or unauthorized account activity. Staff must investigate and document all such occurrences.
context: undocumented transactions
Signs: Unusual account access, undocumented transactions, authority abuse

raw_entities.name: Abuse of Staff Authority Over Customer Accounts
raw_entities.description: A red flag indicating that a staff member is misusing their position or authority to access, modify, or transact on customer accounts beyond their legitimate business purpose. This is a key indicator of insider fraud.
context: authority abuse
Signs: Unusual account access, undocumented transactions, authority abuse

raw_entities.name: Implement Access Controls for Staff Account Access
raw_entities.description: A compliance requirement to establish and maintain access controls that restrict staff members' ability to access customer accounts, limiting access to only those accounts and functions necessary for their role.
context: Prevention: Access controls, audit logs, whistleblower reporting
Access controls

raw_entities.name: Maintain Audit Logs of Staff Account Access
raw_entities.description: A compliance requirement to maintain comprehensive audit logs documenting all staff access to customer accounts and transactions, enabling detection and investigation of suspicious activity.
context: Prevention: Access controls, audit logs, whistleblower reporting
audit logs

raw_entities.name: Establish Whistleblower Reporting Mechanism for Insider Fraud
raw_entities.description: A compliance requirement to establish and maintain a whistleblower reporting mechanism that enables staff and customers to report suspected insider fraud and misconduct without fear of retaliation.
context: Prevention: Access controls, audit logs, whistleblower reporting
whistleblower reporting

properties.name: Unusual Account Access by Staff Member

properties.description: Staff member accesses customer accounts in an unusual or unexpected manner
examples: Access to accounts unrelated to staff member's role
properties.required_action: Investigate the access pattern and determine business justification

properties.description: Transactions appear on customer accounts without proper documentation or authorization trail
examples: Deposits or withdrawals lacking transaction records
properties.required_action: Halt transaction processing and request full documentation; escalate if documentation cannot be provided
properties.escalation_path: Compliance team and fraud investigation unit

properties.name: Abuse of Staff Authority Over Customer Accounts

properties.description: Staff member uses their system access or authority to perform unauthorized actions on customer accounts
examples: Modifying account settings without customer consent
Executing transactions beyond staff member's authorized scope
properties.required_action: Immediately suspend staff member's access; initiate formal investigation
properties.escalation_path: Senior management, compliance team, and internal audit

properties.name: Implement Access Controls for Staff Account Access

properties.description: Establish and enforce role-based access controls limiting staff access to customer accounts to business-justified needs only
properties.verification_method: System configuration audit and access rights review

properties.name: Maintain Audit Logs of Staff Account Access

properties.description: Create and retain comprehensive audit logs recording all staff access to customer accounts, including timestamp, user ID, and actions performed
properties.regulatory_source: Insider fraud prevention and audit trail requirements
properties.verification_method: Audit log review and retention policy compliance check

properties.name: Establish Whistleblower Reporting Mechanism for Insider Fraud

properties.description: Provide confidential channels for staff to report suspected insider fraud without fear of retaliation
properties.regulatory_source: Insider fraud prevention and whistleblower protection requirements
properties.verification_method: Whistleblower policy documentation and reporting channel availability audit
